t_agent_message:
CREATE TABLE `t_agent_message` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `sessionId` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `role` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `subType` varchar(30) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `content` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `tokenCount` int DEFAULT '0',
  `isSummary` int DEFAULT '0',
  `createdTime` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_sessionId` (`sessionId`),
  KEY `idx_createdTime` (`createdTime`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
t_agent_message_outbox:
CREATE TABLE `t_agent_message_outbox` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `sessionId` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `userId` bigint NOT NULL,
  `role` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `subType` varchar(30) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `content` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `status` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `retryCount` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `lastError` varchar(512) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `createdTime` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `deliveredTime` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_session` (`sessionId`),
  KEY `idx_status` (`status`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Agent 消息 Outbox'
t_agent_session:
CREATE TABLE `t_agent_session` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `sessionId` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '会话ID',
  `userId` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT '用户ID',
  `title` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT '新会话' COMMENT '会话标题',
  `modelName` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '模型名称',
  `status` tinyint DEFAULT '1' COMMENT '状态:0结束,1活跃',
  `lastMessage` varchar(500) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT '' COMMENT '最后一条消息',
  `messageCount` int DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '消息数量',
  `summaryContent` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT '摘要内容',
  `summaryAt` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '摘要时间',
  `checkpointData` blob COMMENT '检查点数据',
  `createdTime` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedTime` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `expiredTime` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '过期时间',
  `isDelete` int DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '逻辑删除',
  `pinned` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '是否置顶：0-否，1-是',
  `pinTime` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '置顶时间',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_agent_session_session_id` (`sessionId`),
  KEY `idx_userId` (`userId`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Agent会话表'
t_attachment:
CREATE TABLE `t_attachment` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT 'id',
  `newsId` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT '关联新闻id',
  `url` varchar(512) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '图片 url',
  `order` tinyint DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '段落顺序(用于排序)',
  `description` varchar(200) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT '' COMMENT '图片描述',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='新闻附件表'
t_chat_history:
CREATE TABLE `t_chat_history` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT 'id',
  `message` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '消息',
  `messageType` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'user/ai',
  `sessionId` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT '会话id',
  `userId` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT '创建用户id',
  `createTime` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '创建时间',
  `updateTime` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '更新时间',
  `isDelete` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '是否删除',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_appId` (`sessionId`),
  KEY `idx_createTime` (`createTime`),
  KEY `idx_appId_createTime` (`sessionId`,`createTime`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='对话历史'
t_chatsession:
CREATE TABLE `t_chatsession` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT 'id',
  `title` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '会话标题',
  `userId` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT '创建用户 id',
  `createTime` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '创建时间',
  `updateTime` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '更改时间',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_title` (`title`),
  KEY `idx_userId` (`userId`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='会话'
t_diagnosis:
CREATE TABLE `t_diagnosis` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `url` varchar(512) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `userId` bigint NOT NULL,
  `result` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `confidence` double DEFAULT NULL,
  `probability` double DEFAULT NULL,
  `recommendations` varchar(512) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `details` varchar(512) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `severity` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `reexamineStatus` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `picSize` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `picWidth` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `picHeight` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `picScale` double DEFAULT NULL,
  `picFormat` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `createTime` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `isDelete` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `aiRejected` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `abstainReason` varchar(40) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `modelVersion` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `weightSha256` varchar(128) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `preprocessVersion` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `inferencePolicyVersion` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `calibrationStatus` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `calibratedProbability` double DEFAULT NULL,
  `qualityScore` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `qualityReasons` varchar(512) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `oodStatus` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `oodScore` double DEFAULT NULL,
  `humanReviewStatus` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING_AI',
  `humanReviewerId` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `humanReviewedAt` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `humanReviewNote` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `humanResult` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `humanSeverity` varchar(40) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `humanRecommendations` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_result` (`result`),
  KEY `idx_category` (`severity`),
  KEY `idx_userId` (`userId`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Flyway diagnosis bootstrap'
t_diagnosis_audit:
CREATE TABLE `t_diagnosis_audit` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `diagnosisId` bigint NOT NULL,
  `actorId` bigint NOT NULL,
  `actorRole` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `action` varchar(40) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `payload` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `createdTime` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_diagnosis` (`diagnosisId`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='诊断审计'
t_inference_cache:
CREATE TABLE `t_inference_cache` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `imageHash` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `modelVersion` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `weightSha256` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `preprocessVersion` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `inferencePolicyVersion` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'legacy-unknown',
  `predictedLabel` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `probability` double NOT NULL,
  `calibratedProbability` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `calibrationStatus` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NOT_CALIBRATED',
  `description` varchar(512) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `reliabilityScore` int NOT NULL,
  `topPredictions` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `qualityScore` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `qualityReasons` varchar(512) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `isOod` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `oodScore` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `oodStatus` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NOT_EVALUATED',
  `rejected` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `abstainReason` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `requiresReview` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `createTime` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_inference` (`imageHash`,`modelVersion`,`weightSha256`,`preprocessVersion`,`inferencePolicyVersion`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='推理结果缓存'
t_knowledge_document:
CREATE TABLE `t_knowledge_document` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT 'id',
  `userId` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT '上传用户id',
  `title` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '文档标题',
  `fileName` varchar(512) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '原始文件名',
  `fileUrl` varchar(1024) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'COS存储地址',
  `fileSize` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '文件大小(字节)',
  `fileType` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '文件类型:pdf/md/txt/docx',
  `chunkCount` int DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '分块数量',
  `contentHash` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '内容SHA-256哈希，用于去重',
  `status` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '状态:0=处理中,1=已完成,2=失败',
  `createTime` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '创建时间',
  `updateTime` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '更新时间',
  `isDelete` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '逻辑删除',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_userId` (`userId`),
  KEY `idx_status` (`status`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='知识库文档表'
t_mcp_server:
CREATE TABLE `t_mcp_server` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `userId` bigint NOT NULL,
  `mcpServerCode` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `description` varchar(500) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `installType` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `host` varchar(500) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `deployConfig` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` tinyint DEFAULT '1',
  `createTime` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updateTime` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_mcp_user_code` (`userId`,`mcpServerCode`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Flyway legacy MCP bootstrap'
t_news:
CREATE TABLE `t_news` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT 'id',
  `title` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '新闻标题',
  `userId` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT '创建用户id',
  `content` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '新闻正文（富文本)',
  `summary` varchar(512) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '摘要',
  `coverImg` varchar(512) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '封面图片 url',
  `status` tinyint(1) DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '状态（0草稿/1已发布/2下架）',
  `publishTime` datetime NOT NULL COMMENT '发布时间',
  `editTime` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '修改时间',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_title` (`title`),
  KEY `idx_summary` (`summary`),
  KEY `idx_userId` (`userId`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='新闻'
t_paragraph:
CREATE TABLE `t_paragraph` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT 'id',
  `newsId` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT '关联新闻id',
  `content` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '段落内容',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='新闻段落'
t_upload_task:
CREATE TABLE `t_upload_task` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `taskId` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `userId` bigint NOT NULL,
  `objectKey` varchar(512) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `status` tinyint NOT NULL,
  `retryCount` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `lastError` varchar(512) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `createTime` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updateTime` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_task` (`taskId`),
  KEY `idx_user` (`userId`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='上传任务状态机'
t_user:
CREATE TABLE `t_user` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT 'id',
  `userAccount` varchar(256) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '账号',
  `userPassword` varchar(512) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '密码',
  `userName` varchar(256) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '用户昵称',
  `userAvatar` varchar(1024) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '用户头像',
  `userProfile` varchar(512) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '用户简介',
  `userRole` varchar(256) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user' COMMENT '用户角色：user/admin',
  `editTime` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '编辑时间',
  `createTime` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '创建时间',
  `updateTime` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '更新时间',
  `isDelete` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '是否删除',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_userAccount` (`userAccount`),
  KEY `idx_userName` (`userName`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='用户'
